title: sf-testimpact: change-impact analysis for safe Apex test selection in Salesforce deployments
description: sf-testimpact performs static change-impact analysis for Salesforce. It builds a dependency graph of Apex and metadata, resolves a git diff into that graph, and computes the minimum set of Apex tests a change can affect, so a deployment runs only the relevant tests instead of the full suite. It is a correctness tool governed by the rule "over-approximate freely, under-approximate never": anything unresolvable widens the selection or falls back to running all tests, and reports the rule that fired.
